title: Hubble's Gravitational Lens Gallery Sets Targets for Roman
paragraphs: NASA shared new pictures from the Hubble telescope. They show strong gravitational lenses.
A lens is a heavy galaxy in space. Its gravity bends light from a galaxy far behind it. The far galaxy looks bigger and sometimes like a ring.
The new Roman telescope will look at these places too. Scientists want to learn about dark matter. Dark matter is something we cannot see.
